countryRecords.sourceDiscoveryNote: Initial Hong Kong SAR source discovery, not legal advice or a market screen. All national and district-level reviews remain not-assessed, and release remains blocked. Hong Kong maintains its own legislation and official consolidated laws are published on Hong Kong e-Legislation; verified PDF copies carry legal status. The PDPO’s section 33 cross-border transfer restriction has a complex commencement history and must be checked against current verified law. The Department of Health currently describes MDACS as an administrative control system while a statutory medical-device framework is being developed; verify current status and intended-purpose classification at release. The 18 district queue is a screening scaffold only; it does not cover all local applicability or territory-wide legal duties.
